body_markdown:
I just received the update and absolutely love the listen feature! I used to use Chrome’s “Listen to this page” or Android’s Reading Mode, but NewsBlur’s speed and realistic voices blow those out of the water.


**Feature Request:**


My workflow is to save articles I want to read later, mark everything else in the folder as read, and then view my Saved list sorted from oldest to newest.


Currently, continuous playback automatically moves to another article, but it doesn’t always pick the next oldest article in the sorted list. When there are no unread articles because I’ve already marked them as read, it’s unclear how it decides what to play next. It would be awesome if the listen feature followed the active list order and advanced to the next story in sequence.


P.S. If there’s a better workflow other than what I’m doing that would work better with this feature I’m open to learning about it. Thanks!
